title: Spain Larouco Wildfire Burn-Scar Replay
description: Source-backed Sentinel Hub close look for the August 2025 Larouco/Seadur wildfire in Ourense, Galicia.
task_text: Review the August 2025 Larouco/Seadur wildfire in Ourense, Galicia for post-fire burn scar, active-window smoke/cloud ambiguity, vegetation loss, fireline context, and cross-border landscape impact. Keep claims candidate-only unless source-backed bands, burn indices, or hotspot context support them.
summary: A real Sentinel-2 L2A SWIR/NIR/Red replay seeded from Sentinel Hub. The postfire frame has valid pixels, low cloud support, and positive dNBR burn context, making it a stronger repeatable burn-scar review case than RGB-only smoke inspection.

alerts.timelapse_analysis: The Sentinel-2 L2A SWIR/NIR/Red sequence compares a July-August baseline, an August 16 active-window frame, and a September 5 postfire frame. NBR drops from 0.4521 to 0.2063, NDMI drops from 0.1711 to 0.0434, and the postfire frame has 99.7 percent valid pixels with low SCL cloud support.
alerts.analysis_summary: This replay proves the app can retain a real Spain wildfire burn-scar case from cached Sentinel data, surface positive burn-index support, and avoid active-fire confirmation without hotspot support.
alerts.satellite_note: Orbital triage retained the Larouco postfire burn-scar packet as source-backed wildfire review evidence.
alerts.ground_note: Ground Validator should present this as burn-scar review evidence, not a binary active-fire claim.
alerts.ground_action: REVIEW - Spain Larouco wildfire burn-scar candidate has source-backed dNBR support and low postfire cloud support, but no hotspot context is attached.
findings: The replay uses real Sentinel Hub Sentinel-2 L2A frames cached under sh_09384ab0
The postfire frame keeps valid-pixel and cloud metrics with B02/B03/B04/B08/B11/B12/SCL/CLD/CLP summaries
